title: Timee says contact details of up to 226,662 job-posting business contacts leaked via KARTE breach
summary: Timee said on 19 November that contact details of up to 226,662 people at businesses that post jobs on its service leaked after unauthorized access to KARTE, a web service of its contractor PLAID. The data are email addresses, names, phone numbers and customer-management IDs. Timee says job seekers' data and its login credentials are not included, and no misuse has been confirmed.
plain: A job-matching company says business contacts' emails and some names and phone numbers leaked when a supplier's system was hacked. Job seekers were not affected.
exec: A supplier breach exposed contact details of up to 226,662 client-business contacts, raising phishing risk for Timee's customers.
action: Business contacts of Timee should treat emails, texts or calls claiming to be Timee or PLAID with caution; both say they never ask for passwords or credentials by email or SMS.

validation.note: Timee's own notice read in full; Cybersecurity.com (Japan) relays the same figures and timeline.
